lines.text: Halfway down the icy trail, Kate's boot lace came undone.
With thick gloves on, she couldn't tie it.
Gloves off, fingers numb, two long minutes in the wind.
Tie your boots at the trailhead with warm, bare hands.
Double knot, then tuck the loops in.
If your laces are worn smooth or fuzzy, replace them before winter.
Her laces held all the way down.
Save this before your next winter hike.
